Archived from the original on 7 February 2025. Source states: "Lone house survives Hurricane Ike. photo.description: Launching the Coastal City Adaptation Project, in Quelimane USAID/Mozambique launched the 5 year project, Coastal City Adaptation Project, in Quelimane city.
